tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequence alignment of selected antimicrobial peptides.
footnotes: Red: identical residue in the three sequences; blue: identical residue in two sequences; green: residue with similar chemical-physical characteristics.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Amino acid sequences and characteristics of the parent peptide and the selected derivatives.
footnotes: M.M. (Da), molecular mass (Dalton); GRAVY, grand average of hydropathy; pI, isoelectric point. In red, substituted residue; M.M., GRAVY, pI, and charge calculated by ExPASy tool ProtParam.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: In vitro candidacidal activity of in silico designed peptides (ISDPs) against C. albicans SC5314.
footnotes: 1 EC50, half maximal effective concentration, [mol/liter] × 10−6; 2 EC50 of K10S parent peptide [19].
